title: PrologMCP：为LLM代理提供标准化的Prolog工具接口
summary: PrologMCP是一个任务无关的开源服务器，通过模型上下文协议(MCP)将Prolog暴露为有状态工具，使LLM代理能够将推理任务委托给Prolog求解器。在PARARULE-Plus基准测试中，使用PrologMCP的形式化代理在通用样本上准确率达1.00，在挑战性子集上达0.99，优于标准LLM和推理LLM。
summary_en: PrologMCP is a task-agnostic, open-source server that exposes Prolog as a stateful tool via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling LLM agents to delegate inference to a Prolog solver. On PARARULE-Plus, a formalizer agent with PrologMCP achieves 1.00 accuracy on general samples and 0.99 on challenging subsets, outperforming standard and reasoning LLMs.
